# Sakura Flowers

> A Japanese-inspired floral studio offering handcrafted arrangements for weddings, celebrations, and everyday beauty. Based in London.

## Pages

- /: Home — hero, curated collections, occasion types, studio story, newsletter, contact enquiry form
- /blog: Journal — floristry guides, behind-the-scenes stories, seasonal inspiration
- /blog/welcome-to-sakura: Our story and the philosophy behind the studio

## About

Sakura Flowers is a London-based floral studio founded in 2019, inspired by the Japanese art of ikebana. We create bespoke arrangements using seasonally sourced blooms for weddings, corporate events, birthdays, and quiet everyday moments.
